description: A Black man in a dark bicorne hat and a grey coat with gold embroidery and epaulettes stands on a wet beach at night, with a sword at his side. Around him, soldiers in blue and white uniforms with red trim hold lanterns, and one grips his arm. Behind them a rowboat with sacks sits on the water, and a tall-masted sailing ship with a small flag rides offshore under a stormy sky with a moon. No visible text or frame; the painting fills the image edge to edge.
